case_title.quote: RANJEET GOSWAMI v. STATE OF JHARKHAND & ANR.

number_of_accused.quote: charge-sheeted for the offences under Sections 376, 302 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code, along with three others
number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's status is decided; four were charge-sheeted, so 1 is defensible but incomplete.

accused_gender.quote: he was a juvenile since his date of birth was 10.05.1991
accused_gender.reason: The judgment uses 'he' for the appellant.

accused_age.correct_value: Not stated as a fixed age; DOB 10.05.1991 per certificate, medical board said about 20
accused_age.reason: The judgment gives a date of birth and a medical estimate, though no definitive age.

victim_gender.reason: Victim gender not stated, though s.376 is charged.

offence_category.quote: offences under Sections 376, 302 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code
offence_category.reason: Murder is a reasonable main category, but rape is also charged.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 376, 302 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code

evidence_type.quote: The school leaving certificate was proved by examining the head mistress of the school.
evidence_type.reason: Accurately describes the age evidence, including the medical board opinion.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: since the appellant was a juvenile on the date of occurrence

trial_court_outcome.quote: rejecting the application holding that the appellant was not a juvenile on the date of occurrence
trial_court_outcome.reason: No trial verdict; the JJ Board order is accurately described.

high_court_outcome.quote: The Criminal Revision was allowed and the order passed by the JJ Board was restored

final_outcome.quote: the order passed by the High Court is set aside and that of the Sessions Judge, Dumka is restored
final_outcome.reason: Not a conviction case; the case goes to the JJ Board. 'remanded' is arguably acceptable but 'other' fits better.

imprisonment_type.quote: he can be tried only by the JJ Board
imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence was decided; 'none' implies a sentence determination, while 'not_stated' fits.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Should omit the medical-board and juvenility proceedings and avoid revealing procedural outcomes
neutral_facts.quote: The JJ Board then sought the opinion of the Medical Board
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate but includes JJ Board/medical proceedings and phrases like 'later surrendered'; stays largely factual, no outcome revealed.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: She has recognized the signatures of the principal who issued the school leaving certificate.

witness_credibility.quote: The evidence adduced by the head mistress was not challenged.

legal_representation.quote: Shankar Narayanan (for Gaurav Agrawal) for the Appellant.

procedural_irregularity.quote: no cogent reasons have been stated by the High court to discard the school leaving certificate

prosecution_argument.quote: the High Court has rightly accepted the report of the medical board

defence_argument.quote: question of accepting the report of the medical board arises only if the school leaving certificate is discarded

legal_principle_applied.quote: there is no question of subjecting the accused to a medical examination by a medical board

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Ashwani Kumar Saxena v. State of M.P. 2012 (10) SCR 540 = 2012 (9) SCC 750
